verdict: Sector-specific charged spurions repair deck typing but cannot create the missing full kernel. On every invertible spurion fiber they only rescale independent columns. Zero spurions create route deletion, not destructive interference. A genuine activation requires a non-diagonal charged correspondence that changes the transport or its target quotient.
